stem: The time, in minutes, spent by customers at a particular gym has the distribution $\text{N}(\mu, 38.2)$. In the past the value of $\mu$ has been 42.4. Following the installation of some new equipment the management wishes to test whether the value of $\mu$ has changed.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State what is meant by a Type I error in this context.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
The mean time for a sample of 20 customers is found to be 45.6 minutes.

Test at the 2.5% significance level whether the value of $\mu$ has changed.
